newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel gains with NYMEX, but few deals seen.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel gains with NYMEX, but few deals seen.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices rose moderately with NYMEX December futures Thursday, but players said few deals were done as the market focused instead on other distillates.

Differentials remained stable on aviation-quality 54-grade fuel in both centers, players said, with New York Harbor material pegged at 1.85 cents above December NYMEX and back-31st cycle Gulf material sold for 0.60 cent below the print.
"The jet fuel market was just nonexistent. There's little interest in the jet barrel," one Gulf trader said.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1632
